description:
## 0.0.22-10 (Muthu build)

Built from Muthu1203-abi/Hushgram on HushGram 0.0.22, synced with SysAdminDoc/HushGram up to 634cb4994. For Instagram 457.0.0.55.73.

* Double tap the top of a reel to share: a double tap near the top of a reel opens its share sheet instead of liking it, in clear mode too. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels, with a Share area slider for how much of the reel counts.
* Hide the Share button is removed.
